scope: Attribute the c2s 0x012E EventUpdate emitter (the pcap-opcode-coverage-matrix pass's rank 2 c2s gap, 200 pcap hits). Hunt via FindOpcodeImmediate.java for instructions whose immediate equals 0x12E, then decomp the candidates in the EventStart wrapper neighborhood (FUN_0075Exxx).

FUN_0075E670 confirmed as 0x012E builder: writes local_8c0 = 0x12e (opcode) + local_8bc = 0x68 (body length 104 bytes) to a 0x8C0-byte stack record, then bulk-copies 16 dwords (64 bytes) from param_6 into local_897, then calls FUN_004d6d30(&local_8c0, 0, 0). Eliminates FUN_00471F70 (OpenSSL bn_lib.c line 0x12E - source-line argument, not opcode) and FUN_00C12D40 (Vfx DataTableMap.cpp line 0x12E - same).
method.step3: Decomp the call chain: caller FUN_00894090 (SEH-wrapped: builds actor record via FUN_00cc73b0 + calls FUN_0075e670 + critical-section cleanup) with 3 upstream callers (FUN_00894ab0 + FUN_00894bc0 + FUN_00896f70). key_findings: FUN_0075E670 is the c2s 0x012E EventUpdate emitter. Located at 0x0075E670 - directly adjacent in .text to the EventStart wrappers (BCS-Y-0426..0429: 0x0075E1C0/E230/E3A0/E510). Sibling pattern but STACK-RECORD variant: builds the wire record in a 0x8C0-byte local frame rather than the caller-supplied buffer FUN_00776760 uses.

Wire format (from decomp): local_8c0 = 0x012E (opcode at record[0]), local_8bc = 0x68 (body length 104 = decimal 104; matches dispatch protocol header size, not the 120-byte pcap-opcode-evidence-pass observation - the 16-byte difference is likely the BasePacket+SubPacket framing overhead the dispatch struct doesn't count). Body builder loop copies 16 dwords (64 bytes) from param_6 into local_897+. Other params include actor IDs and an 8-bit flag at param_5.

FUN_004D6D30 is a SHARED gating thunk for the entire event-family c2s emit chain - 14 callers including ALL FUN_0075Exxx event-builder wrappers (0x0075E1C0/E230/E3A0/E510/E670/E770/E860/E8D0/E950/EA50/EAC0/EBA0/ECD0/0076E270). Same shape as FUN_004D6CF0 (BCS-Y-0323 c2s 0x0007 ZoneInComplete thunk): gates on a runtime flag at param_1+0x174ec before forwarding to FUN_004E0240 (the terminal wire-send, BCS-Y-0312).

FUN_00894090 is the SEH-wrapped upstream wrapper for the 0x012E emit path. 3 contextual callers (FUN_00894ab0 / FUN_00894bc0 / FUN_00896f70) - three different event-update trigger contexts (likely script-driven, NPC-driven, and timer-driven, but precise context attribution would need additional decomp).

Pattern note: 0x012E EventUpdate uses the SAME architectural dispatch as 0x012D EventStart (event-family builder -> FUN_004D6D30 gating thunk -> FUN_004E0240 terminal wire-send). Confirms client-architecture '1.x combat is asymmetric': combat action commands semantically ride the 0x012D EventStart frame, while 0x012E carries follow-up updates from script-driven event progression.
